profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer - GitHub AI
profile.summary:
I make awesome stuff at Microsoft and GitHub, so developers can make awesome stuff.  I'm currently focused on GitHub Coding Agents, Copilot, and other emerging tech in Microsoft's Developer Division (GitHub).

https://github.com/colbylwilliams

positions.title: President
positions.description: A small record label changing everything.

positions.title: Client Partner
positions.description:
Globant is a global technology service provider & consulting firm focused on delivering innovative software solutions by leveraging emerging technologies

Responsible for development, growth, and profitability of key customer accounts.

positions.title: Technical Lead - Global Black Belt - App Innovation, Intelligent Cloud
positions.description:
A technical solutions professional within Microsoft’s enterprise sales organization with a special focus on application development and advanced workloads, primarily working with Global Systems Integrators and Digital Agencies.

Managed a team of five Global Black Belt, Technical Solutions Professionals located across the globe.

Key technical leader and influencer in shaping customer decisions to buy, architect and adopt Microsoft Application Development solutions through technical presentations, demonstrations, proof of concepts, designing and implementing solutions leveraging internal and external consultants as needed.

Technical advisor in creating Microsoft’s go-to-market strategies for the world wide sales organization.
  
Spoke regularly at internal and external technical conferences around the world about cloud architecture, serverless, and AI.

Designed and created Azure's next generation Mobile Back End as a Service SDKs that connect to Cosmos DB and Azure App Service.

Wrote several native mobile SDKs for Microsoft's Cognitive Services and Bot Framework.

positions.title: Sr. Partner Engineer - Xamarin
positions.description:
Microsoft acquired Xamarin in March 2016.

Continued to lead the Partner Engineering team created while at Xamarin (see below) shifting our technical sales and enablement focus to all mobile platforms and Microsoft’s Azure cloud services.

positions.title: Sr. Partner Engineer
positions.description:
Technical enablement of Xamarin Consulting Partners working closely with Global SI and consulting service partners serving the Enterprise market on mobile strategy, architecture and mobile roadmaps.

Xamarin Partners represent the most capable mobile application developers across the globe, delivering native mobile application experiences for enterprise clients throughout the world.

positions.title: Founder
positions.description:
Everything, including development of the iOS application in Swift.

----

bugTrap Inc. creates software to help mobile application developers get the information they need to create amazing experiences.

bugTrap for iOS empowers users and testers to easily send meaningful mobile app and site feedback directly from device to developer. 

Take a screenshot, annotate it and submit the issue and image to your existing tracking system; all from the same app.

positions.title: Mobile Lead
positions.description:
Started at a five-person, web-focused digital agency and began building out mobile practice that eventually became the primary focus of the agency.

Built and managed a team of mobile developers, while remaining intimately involved in sales.

Bluetube was acquired by Perficient, Inc. in Oct. 2016 with 40 employees and annual services revenue of $7 million.

positions.title: Web Developer, Aviation IT Strategic Services
positions.description: Worked with an internal team at the Airport to design and develop a new mobile website.

positions.title: Founder
positions.description: Design and develop e-commerce websites for small brick-and-mortar businesses using e- commerce enabled content management systems like BigCommerce.

positions.title: Outside Sales Representative
positions.description: Large area sales representative for an industry leader actively selling portfolio of over 45,000 products to 200 existing accounts.

volunteerExperiences.description: Advise Madison City's Board of Education on technology and industry trends, tools, resources, and programs in support of technical innovation and education.
